body:
Commit 3b30a74. Continuing PARENA_COREUTILS_NORTHSTAR.md Phase 3d. source/.: reads a real file, runs it through the exact same exec_range everything else uses, in-process so assignments/functions persist. Attempted the real target -- OpenRC own /lib/rc/sh/functions.sh -- and found by reading it directly: needs real arithmetic expansion, case/esac, local, and eval, none of which this shell has yet. Real # comments: found live testing source against a real script -- every comment was executed as a bogus "#: not found" command (prior testing always stripped comments manually, masking this). Real brace-on-own-line functions (name() then newline then brace): exposed by the comment fix, two distinct real bugs fixed -- func_def_brace_index tolerates an optional ; between () and {, and a subtler is_balanced bug where NAME() alone looked complete and got executed as a bogus command one statement too early. 8 new real end-to-end assertions, all pass alongside the original 32. make test: 347/347, zero regressions. Real, honest conclusion: this shell can source files and define/call functions in either brace style, but running OpenRC functions.sh end-to-end still needs arithmetic/case/local/eval.

⚓ ☃
title: parenash: real source/., comments, brace-on-own-line functions — 2 more real bugs found and fixed live
